```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

from pathlib import Path
from html import escape
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
import yaml
from IPython.display import HTML, display

with Path("content/data_server.yml").open(encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    content = yaml.safe_load(stream) or {}

def e(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def link_button(button, variant="primary"):
    if not isinstance(button, dict) or not button.get("url"):
        return ""

    css = (
        "cw-erddap-btn-primary"
        if variant == "primary"
        else "cw-erddap-btn-secondary"
    )

    url = str(button["url"])
    external = url.startswith(("https://", "http://"))
    href = url[:-4] + ".html" if url.endswith(".qmd") else url

    extra = (
        ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"'
        if external else ""
    )

    return (
        f'<a class="cw-erddap-btn {css}" '
        f'href="{e(href)}"{extra}>'
        f'{e(button.get("label", "Learn more"))}</a>'
    )

def render_links(links):
    if not links:
        return ""

    items = []

    for item in links:
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not item.get("url"):
            continue

        url = str(item["url"])
        href = url[:-4] + ".html" if url.endswith(".qmd") else url
        external = url.startswith(("https://", "http://"))

        extra = (
            ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"'
            if external else ""
        )

        items.append(
            f'<li><a href="{e(href)}"{extra}>'
            f'{e(item.get("label", url))}</a></li>'
        )

    return (
        '<ul class="cw-erddap-links">'
        + "".join(items)
        + "</ul>"
        if items else ""
    )

def video_embed(url):
    parsed = urlparse(str(url or ""))
    video_id = ""

    if parsed.hostname in ("youtu.be", "www.youtu.be"):
        video_id = parsed.path.strip("/").split("/")[0]

    elif parsed.hostname in (
        "youtube.com",
        "www.youtube.com",
        "m.youtube.com",
        "www.youtube-nocookie.com",
    ):
        if parsed.path == "/watch":
            video_id = parse_qs(parsed.query).get("v", [""])[0]
        elif parsed.path.startswith(("/embed/", "/shorts/")):
            video_id = parsed.path.split("/")[2]

    if not video_id or not all(
        c.isalnum() or c in "_-" for c in video_id
    ):
        return ""

    return f'''
    <div class="cw-erddap-video">
      <iframe
        src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/{e(video_id)}"
        title="ERDDAP tutorial"
        loading="lazy"
        allowfullscreen
      ></iframe>
    </div>
    '''

hero = content.get("hero", {})
features = content.get("features", {})
learning = content.get("learning", {})

parts = ['<main class="cw-erddap">']

# HERO

parts.append(f'''
<section class="cw-erddap-hero">
  <span class="cw-erddap-eyebrow">
    {e(hero.get("eyebrow", "DATA ACCESS & SERVICES"))}
  </span>

  <h1>{e(hero.get("title", "ERDDAP Data Server"))}</h1>

  <p>{e(hero.get("description", ""))}</p>

  <div class="cw-erddap-actions">
    {link_button(hero.get("primary_button"), "primary")}
    {link_button(hero.get("secondary_button"), "secondary")}
  </div>
</section>
''')

# FEATURE CARDS

parts.append(f'''
<section class="cw-erddap-section">
  <span class="cw-erddap-eyebrow">
    {e(features.get("eyebrow", "WHY ERDDAP"))}
  </span>

  <h2>{e(features.get("title", "Getting data is easy"))}</h2>

  <div class="cw-erddap-feature-grid">
''')

for index, card in enumerate(features.get("cards", []), start=1):
    parts.append(f'''
    <article class="cw-erddap-feature">
      <span class="cw-erddap-feature-number">{index:02d}</span>
      <h3>{e(card.get("title"))}</h3>
      <p>{e(card.get("description"))}</p>
    </article>
    ''')

parts.append("</div></section>")

# ERDDAP BASICS

parts.append(f'''
<section class="cw-erddap-section cw-erddap-learning">
  <span class="cw-erddap-eyebrow">
    {e(learning.get("eyebrow", "LEARN & EXPLORE"))}
  </span>

  <h2>{e(learning.get("title", "ERDDAP basics"))}</h2>

  <p class="cw-erddap-section-desc">
    {e(learning.get("description", ""))}
  </p>

  <div class="cw-erddap-accordions">
''')

for section in learning.get("sections", []):

    kind = section.get("kind", "links")

    parts.append(f'''
    <details class="cw-erddap-accordion">
      <summary>
        {e(section.get("title"))}
        <span class="cw-erddap-plus" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
      </summary>

      <div class="cw-erddap-accordion-content">
    ''')

    for paragraph in section.get("paragraphs", []):
        parts.append(f"<p>{e(paragraph)}</p>")

    if kind == "request":

        if section.get("url_pattern"):
            parts.append(f'''
            <div class="cw-erddap-code">
              <code>{e(section["url_pattern"])}</code>
            </div>
            ''')

        terms = section.get("terms", [])

        if terms:
            parts.append('<dl class="cw-erddap-terms">')

            for term in terms:
                parts.append(f'''
                <div>
                  <dt>{e(term.get("name"))}</dt>
                  <dd>{e(term.get("description"))}</dd>
                </div>
                ''')

            parts.append("</dl>")

    elif kind == "formats":

        parts.append('<div class="cw-erddap-format-grid">')

        for group in section.get("format_groups", []):

            extensions = [
                x.strip()
                for x in str(group.get("extensions", "")).split(",")
                if x.strip()
            ]

            chips = "".join(
                f"<code>{e(ext)}</code>"
                for ext in extensions
            )

            parts.append(f'''
            <div>
              <h4>{e(group.get("title"))}</h4>
              <div class="cw-erddap-format-chips">
                {chips}
              </div>
            </div>
            ''')

        parts.append("</div>")

    elif kind == "video":

        if section.get("heading"):
            parts.append(
                f'<h4>{e(section["heading"])}</h4>'
            )

        if section.get("description"):
            parts.append(
                f'<p>{e(section["description"])}</p>'
            )

        parts.append(video_embed(section.get("youtube_url")))

    parts.append(render_links(section.get("links", [])))
    parts.append("</div></details>")

parts.append("</div></section></main>")

display(HTML("\n".join(parts)))
```
